description: A scope's settings as the viewer's settings panel reads and changes them over HTTP.

SettingEffect.description: When a change takes effect: at once, on a viewer's next connection, on the device next brought up, or when the daemon restarts.

SettingReach.description: Whom a setting is for: each scope, or only the whole daemon.

SettingLayer.description: Where a value comes from, lowest first: the default, config.toml, the scope's table in it, a SIM_MIRROR_* variable, or the command line.

SettingsAccess.description: What the asker may do: read only, change what is not sensitive, or change everything.

SettingsTarget.description: Whether a change is for this scope alone or for every scope.

WholeRule.description: A whole number from low to high.

TextRule.description: One line of text: a name, a path, a build configuration or a connector's name.

suggestions.description: Values worth offering to pick from, such as the connectors installed; any other the rule allows may still be typed.

OriginsRule.description: A list of web origins, such as http://localhost:3000.

RuleSpec.description: What a setting's value may be, told apart by kind.

SettingValue.description: A setting's value: a flag, a whole number, text, or a list of text.

detail.description: What in the layer set it: the file, the scope's table, or the variable.

SettingsSection.description: A tab of the panel: a top-level table of config.toml.

id.description: The table's name; empty for the top of the file.

path.description: Where it lives in config.toml, such as stream.fps.

sensitive.description: It decides what SimMirror runs or who may reach it: a page changes it only once a person confirms at the terminal.

locked.description: Why it cannot be changed here -- such as a variable setting it -- or null when it can.

command.description: How to change it at the terminal instead.

SettingsView.description: Every setting as a scope sees it, grouped into sections, and what the asker may do with them.

notice.description: What the asker should know before changing anything -- such as how to open settings that may be changed -- or null.

SettingsChange.description: Values to set and settings to put back to what the layer below says, all or none.

confirmation.description: The code `sim-mirror settings confirm` printed, for a change that includes a sensitive setting.

PendingConfirmation.description: A sensitive change waiting for a person to confirm it at the terminal.

summary.description: What the change does, as the terminal shows it.

command.description: The command that shows the change and its code.

SettingsRefusal.description: A change refused, with each setting's problem, or the confirmation it waits for.
